supported_rank_rtol.selector: fisher_rank_rtol used to regenerate identifiability labels

waveform_only_r2_k.selector: feature_set=waveform_only; model=RandomForestRegressor; target=k; metric=R2; mean over folds

waveform_only_r2_wq.selector: feature_set=waveform_only; model=RandomForestRegressor; target=wq; metric=R2; mean over folds

waveform_proxy_r2_k.selector: feature_set=waveform_plus_geodesics; model=HistGradientBoostingRegressor; target=k; metric=R2; mean over folds

waveform_proxy_r2_wq.selector: feature_set=waveform_plus_geodesics; model=HistGradientBoostingRegressor; target=wq; metric=R2; mean over folds

identifiability_macro_f1.selector: feature_set=all_features; model=RandomForestClassifier; metric=macro_F1; mean over folds

weakly_identifiable_fraction.selector: all_features RandomForestClassifier; unique physical_id; fraction true_class=weakly_identifiable

waveform_noise_break_fraction.selector: waveform_only wq MAE; first noise level above 1.25x clean MAE

scalar_wq_mae.selector: feature_set=all current scalar observables; mean abs_error_wq

extended_wq_mae.selector: feature_set=current scalars + independent geodesic observables; mean abs_error_wq

near_zero_min_singular_improvement.selector: region=nearest sampled band to k=0; median

near_zero_condition_improvement.selector: region=nearest sampled band to k=0; median
